exclusions.automatic_compaction, post_turn_compacti: the compaction pipeline (a summarizer over the session) is not recorded here: the turns section sets the intent a compaction leaves (manual_compaction) and the guard cases give the comparison each compaction intent
exclusions.deferred_body_compaction: no product path sets it: provider-prefix-guard.mjs:5-10 only accepts it as a compaction intent; the setters of a cache-break intent are pre-send-compact.mjs:461,613 (automatic_compaction), compaction-runner.mjs:737 (post_turn_compaction, manual_compaction), request-boundary.mjs:75,88 (tool_surface_bridge_migration, transcript_rebuild)
exclusions.request_properties_changed: no product path reaches it: request-projection.mjs:52-58 hands the guard a prefix of the two tool lists only, and provider-prefix-guard.mjs:176-196 digests each list on its own, so a changed prefix with the same provider, model and both list digests cannot occur (the guard cases give the guard a prefix with another key)

keptWhole: the cache_break lines of the local trace file, per route step its transcript, provider, native tools, send count, refusal, rows and stderr lines, the [cache-break] stderr lines, each request's message and image count, per payload record its payload, row and stderr line, per turn its rows, stderr lines and record fields, per guard case both fingerprints, the details told and the refusal, per prefix body the persisted fingerprint and the changes

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

syntheticInputs: the loop: a system prompt and one user turn of text and one image; a provider named anthropic whose first send throws "Could not process image" with status 400 and whose second answers "ok"
Date.now fixed at 1700000000000; MIXDOG_DIAGNOSTICS=1 so the local trace file is written
the payload records: synthetic values reaching every buildCacheBreakPayload field

the turns: six agentLoop turns of one anthropic session (a 5m messages cache) with the usage, model and tools given per turn, and a manual compaction's rewritten transcript and pending intent before the fourth
the guard cases: synthetic transcripts and request prefixes reaching every prepareProviderPrefixGuard branch
the prefix bodies: synthetic Anthropic request bodies moving each fingerprinted block, marker and message breakpoint
